title: Archive: August and September sessions move to the Passport drive, a stub keeps them on the Sessions page

chat.text: Phase 2 of the repo-size plan: the 670 MB of August and September session folders are copied to E:/Projects/lew42/archive (counts and bytes verified), each month leaves the working tree in one commit that says how to undo, and a stub per month keeps every session listed on the Sessions page with a link to the archive. Git history keeps everything; the readers (index, follow-up, past work, the Sessions page) are proven afterwards.
